note: What the report folder does with the game logs (docs/ui/report-logs.md, X-28): the two logs it copies, how much of each, the marker (one file per running game, run-marker-<process id>.txt) that says a run did not close properly, and the patterns that clean a copy before it is written. patterns and allow_lines mirror tools/report-scan.json (Tools; tools/ is not in an export, so the game reads this copy; hud_check fails if the two differ). Order matters: a user folder is cut before a drive path is looked for.
